title: Internal: Replacement Cards - Expedited Shipping Frequency
content:
## Frequency Limit

- Expedited shipping on replacement credit cards is limited to one expedited replacement per credit card account in any rolling 12-month period. This applies to every card tier, including tiers where expedited shipping is complimentary.

## Checking Prior Replacements

- Before offering expedited shipping, review the account's replacement history with get_pending_replacement_orders_5765. The tool lists every replacement order on the account, including delivered ones, with the order date and whether it shipped expedited.

## When the Limit Has Been Reached

- If an expedited replacement was ordered for the account within the last 12 months, place the new replacement with standard delivery (expedited_shipping: false) and let the customer know to expect it in 7–10 business days.
